_README.description: Alibaba Qwen via DashScope OpenAI-compatible API (native provider, DASHSCOPE_API_KEY).
_README.usage: Base URL https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1. Qwen-Max is closed/API-first, so this direct route reaches models not practically self-hostable. Scores pinned to the qwen/* OpenRouter mirrors. Model IDs verified against DashScope docs 2026-08; re-check /models if a call 404s.

models.description: Alibaba Qwen3.8 Max 0902 (2026-09-01 snapshot) - post-trained for coding and agent work; #1 on Code Arena WebDev (1691), narrowly over Claude Opus 5 Max. Artificial Analysis Index v4.3 lists this snapshot at 45 (checked 2026-09-24), which maps to 17, above base Max (40). Native multimodal, 1M context. Direct DashScope API.
Alibaba Qwen3.8 Max - flagship (1T+ params, closed/API-first). Superseded by the qwen3.8-max-0902 snapshot. Direct DashScope API.

Alibaba Qwen3.8 Flash - production serving of the Flash-Next architecture (hosted SKU 'qwen3.8-flash'; 1M context, text+image+video). Score pinned to the family's Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 40; note AA scored the open-weight Flash-Next checkpoint, and the hosted checkpoint differs slightly. Direct DashScope API.
